items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

ctx.x: Well this has really been just a treat. When is the next unexpected time I might hear you on television do you suppose?
I’ll be on the 28th, on the Burt Reynolds movie. It’s called “Hard Time,” on Ted Turner’s network, TNT.
Oh you’re in it? And you play on it?
